sermon.title: Review of July 29, 2018 08/19/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In a short review of the July 29 message, Pastor David G. Kincer repeats that God and the Bible are not on trial, that the Bible is a book of truth summed up in loving God and neighbor, that not every believer is a Christian or disciple, and that Christians must beware philosophies that aim to silence them.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: He again cites “John 17:11” (John 17:17) and “Psalms 119 59” (Psalm 119:160); his words kept, the correct passages linked.
